# Jai Varahi Peedam (Sri Kottai Varahi Amman Temple)

> Sri Kottai Varahi Amman Devasthanam & Charitable Trust — Authentic Vedic Temple, Shakta Upasana Peedam, Astrology Guidance, and Social Seva Trust located in Katpadi, Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India.
> Official Website: https://www.jaivarahi.org

## Overview & Spiritual Founder
Jai Varahi Peedam is an ordained Hindu Shakta shrine and spiritual institution founded by **Swamy Pallur Varahidhasan**. Dedicated primarily to **Goddess Sri Maha Varahi Amman** (the commander-in-chief of Goddess Lalitha Tripurasundari's divine forces) along with **Ashtamukha Varahi**, **Uchchishta Ganapati**, and **Sri Bala Tripurasundari**. The institution conducts traditional Agamic rituals, Vedic Homams, astrological consultations, nithya annadhanam, gosala cow protection, and rural education initiatives.

## Geographic Location & Contact Details
- **Temple Address**: Sri Kottai Varahi Amman Temple Street, Arumparuthi, Katpadi, Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India — PIN 632106
- **Geo Coordinates**: 12.6167° N, 78.8428° E (Latitude: 12.6167, Longitude: 78.8428)
- **Primary Contact**: +91 90928 78389

- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Sunday, 06:30 AM – 12:30 PM & 04:30 PM – 08:30 PM IST
- **80G Tax Exemption**: Voluntary contributions are eligible for income tax exemption under Section 80G of the Indian Income Tax Act.

## Key Rituals & Auspicious Days
- **Nithya Pooja**: Morning and evening abhishekam and archana performed every single day.
- **Rahu Kaala Pooja**: Tuesday (3:00 PM – 4:30 PM), Friday (10:30 AM – 12:00 PM), and Sunday (4:30 PM – 6:00 PM) specifically for overcoming court disputes, business hurdles, and negative energies.
- **Theipirai Panchami Homam**: The 5th waning lunar day, highly potent for victory over adversaries and debt clearance.
- **Valarpirai Ashtami**: The 8th waxing lunar day, propitious for health, vitality, and spiritual protection.
- **Pournami (Full Moon) & Amavasya (New Moon)**: Maha Abishekam and Sri Chakra Archana.

## Charitable Projects
1. **Nithya Annadhanam Seva**: Daily distribution of sanctified vegetarian meals to visiting devotees and underprivileged rural communities.
2. **Sri Varahi Kosala**: Humane sheltering, medical care, and continuous green fodder feeding for sacred native cows.
3. **Vedic Education Support**: Distribution of educational materials and assistance to rural students.
4. **Sacred Prasadham Postal Delivery**: Devotees across India and globally receive consecrated Vibhuti, Kumkum, and Raksha threads via tracked courier.
